en: Color postcard showing a large central square with gardens, steps, and fountains. Dominating the view is a historic stone building with a prominent green dome, with surrounding classical buildings, statues, and a horse-mounted statue at the right edge. The reverse side carries Hungarian handwriting, printed multilingual caption identifying the square, a Hungarian postage stamp, and address lines.
